text:
lina: Heads-up — prepping the marketplace onboarding for SI customer tomorrow. Need driver/CUDA/ROCm pin decision and a hotfix path if the quant kernel shows up in canary.
raj: Thanks. What pins are we proposing?
lina: Proposal (from infra):
```
CUDA: 12.3.1
NVIDIA driver: 535.86
ROCm: 5.7
Kernel: 5.15.x tested
```
emily: Ran smoke in us-west-2 with that stack. No functional regressions. Small perf delta on A100 80GB with batch>8 for long seqs.
kevin: For marketplace packaging let's add a fallback image tag that uses the previous driver/kernel combo. Consumers can flip if they see perf regressions.
lina: Can we have fallback tag `redwood/mkt-image:v1.2-fallback`?
emily: I can build it today. Will add a startup probe that fails fast if the quant kernels don't register.
aws_jane: SI side: they want canary window 10pm-2am PT, daily health reports, and commit signoff by EOD.
raj: Signoff checklist: final pins agreed; fallback image pushed; canary schedule confirmed; rollback playbook + contacts; announcement copy for marketplace listing.
kevin: I'll draft the marketplace blurb and call out the pinned stack + upgrade path.
lina: Quick rollback playbook: 1) If canary perf/regression -> flip traffic to fallback image within 15m. 2) If persistent -> rollback model variant to quant-safe build. 3) Open incident and page eng-oncall + partners oncall. (doc: https://go.redwood/marketplace-onboard)
emily: Fallback image queued, ETA ~40m. Will tag `v1.2-fallback` when done.
aws_jane: SI confirms 10pm-2am PT window and will run their workload. Need on-call number for the window.
lina: On-call is eng-oncall rotation, pager is in the doc. Raj, can you be secondary for the window?
raj: Yep, I can be secondary.
kevin: Announcement blurb sent to partners for signoff.
deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline started for `redwood/mkt-image:v1.2` -> canary (us-west-2). CI passed: 38/38.
lina: Final ask to partners: ack pins + canary schedule by 17:00 PT or we'll default to these pins and proceed. :thumbsup: 
aws_jane: Ack from SI — pins & schedule OK. Will share runbook notes after first canary hour.
emily: Fallback image pushed and tagged at 1748213380.
raj: Ready for canary from our side.
lina: Thanks all — will monitor the first 30m and report back.
